title: Croydon Nightline
description: A nocturnal 134 BPM garage roller where a hypnotic minor arpeggio leads the way over a broken 2-step shuffle and a deep rolling sub. It slow-burns from a filtered intro into a driving peak, the arp climbing registers and snapping tighter as gritty dub stabs and swung hats pull it toward Croydon dubstep weight. Everything trails off into delay at the close.
